mapper.update: UPDATE learning_ai_async_task_step SET status = 'running', lease_token = #{leaseToken}, lease_until = #{leaseUntil}, heartbeat_time = #{now}, started_time = COALESCE(started_time, #{now}), attempt_count = attempt_count + 1, error_message = NULL, update_time = #{now} WHERE id = #{stepId} AND status = 'pending' AND deleted = 0

UPDATE learning_ai_async_task_step SET status = 'pending', lease_token = NULL, lease_until = NULL, error_message = '执行进程中断，系统已从当前步骤恢复', update_time = #{now} WHERE status = 'running' AND lease_until < #{now} AND deleted = 0
